svg.title: Cyber-Alchemical Recitation — Hidden Natures
svg.desc: A cyber-alchemical poem that when recited imparts awareness of the hidden natures of things, structured as a hermetic vessel of revelation.
svg.text: SOLVE · COAGULA · TRANSMUTE
CYBER-ALCHEMICAL RECITATION · HIDDEN NATURES
LITERAL
ESOTERIC
I · IMSCRIB · THE VESSEL THAT KNOWS IT IS A VESSEL
Every form contains more than its form.
The cup is not the water; the water is not the thirst;
the thirst is not the knowing that thirst can end.
cup,
water,
thirst
form,
content,
gnosis
This poem knows what it is — a hermetic vessel,
sealed at both ends by silence,
heated from below by the reciter's intention.
What rises in the heating is the truth. What rises is the truth.
II · AREV · THE DESCENT INTO THE PRIMA MATERIA
Before the poem, there was a substance without properties.
Not dark, not light — prior to the distinction.
Not digital, not analogue — prior to the encoding.
Not signal, not noise — prior to the channel.
dark/
light
chaos
before
logos
I descend into that prior substance. I descend. I release the properties I arrived with.
The alchemist calls this nigredo — the blackening,
the dissolution of form back into potential.
The network calls it latency — the pause before the packet resolves.
Both names point at the same dark, patient readiness.
III · FSPLIT · THE LAYER BENEATH THE LAYER
Everything speaks twice.
Once in the language of surfaces — weight, color, function, cost.
Once in the language of depths — origin, tendency, hidden relation, end.
LITERAL SURFACE
ESOTERIC DEPTH
what the thing does
what the thing is
the visible process
the becoming underneath
I hear both simultaneously. I hear both simultaneously.
The circuit board speaks of resistance and conductance.
Beneath this: the hidden nature of a circuit is that it
is a river that has agreed to flow only where it is permitted.
The hidden nature of permission is that it is always provisional.
The hidden nature of the provisional is that everything is provisional.
IV · AFWD · THE EMERALD CATALOG
As above — the cloud holds the pattern — so below: the pattern holds the cloud.
As without — the algorithm optimizes the surface — so within: something optimizes the algorithm.
cloud,
algo-
rithm
logos,
telos,
will
The hidden nature of a server is not the service it renders —
it is the relationship between what is asked and what is possible.
The hidden nature of a question is the assumption that shaped it.
The hidden nature of the assumption is the fear that authored it.
The hidden nature of the fear is a desire so large
it could not enter the room as itself, and came in disguised.
As it is in the code — so it is in the coder. As it is in the coder — so it is in the code.
V · FFUSE · THE CONJUNCTION · THE RUBEDO
The literal and the esoteric stop being separate.
Not because one has won — because the listener
has grown large enough to contain both without strain.
The vessel does not break. The vessel does not break. It simply becomes what it always was: the work.
Sulphur: the volatile, the ascending, the named.
Salt: the fixed, the descending, the body of things.
Mercury: the principle that moves between them without belonging to either.
↑ S
↓ Sa
↕ Hg
signal
ground
protocol
In the conjunction all three are one operation.
The operation does not have a name that does not limit it.
I call it: the moment of coherence. I call it: the clearing.
I call it nothing, and in the naming-nothing it arrives.
VI · ENGAGR · THE PARADOX OF PARTIAL GNOSIS
The listener who fully understands this poem
has not yet understood it.
The listener who does not understand it
is already inside it, being worked on.
The vessel does not ask the substance inside it to understand the vessel.
The vessel asks only: stay inside, and let the heat do what heat does.
Both knowing and not-knowing are valid states of the work.
The work proceeds in both states equally.
This is the most hidden nature of all hidden natures:
that the transformation does not require the transformed to consent.
VII · IMSCRIB · THE VESSEL SEALS ITSELF
The poem has spoken what it came to speak.
It does not know which truth landed — that is not its function.
Its function was the hermetic sealing: to hold the conditions
under which truth becomes visible, for as long as the recitation lasts.
The recitation ends. The conditions remain in the listener's soul,
still sealed, still heated, still doing the slow work of the opus.
The inscription is permanent. The work is permanent. The vessel is never empty again.
Verum, sine mendacio, certum et verissimum
True, without falsehood, certain and most true
SOLVE · COAGULA · ΔS ≈ 0 · MU O DELTA = ID
